claims.text: The hotel is just south of City Hall in Center City, with easy access to the business district.

findings.quote: Just south of City Hall in Center City, the W Philadelphia offers prime access to the city's business district.

claims.text: Reading Terminal Market is a short walk away.

findings.quote: Don't miss Reading Terminal Market, a short walk away, for quintessentially Philly food.

claims.text: The Avenue of the Arts, with its theaters and music venues, stretches just south of the hotel.

findings.quote: The Avenue of the Arts with its theaters and music venues stretches just south, making the hotel an ideal location for culture buffs, too.

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling views of the city.

findings.quote: Floor-to-ceiling views in your hotel room in downtown Philadelphia bring the city to your bed.

claims.text: Some rooms have mural-like headboards showing Philly neighborhoods or light fixtures inspired by Benjamin Franklin's lightning rod experiments.

findings.quote: Some rooms have mural-like headboards with abstracted views of Philly neighborhoods or custom light fixtures inspired by Benjamin Franklin's lightning rod experiments.

claims.text: Many suites have soaking tubs or private balconies.

findings.quote: Many of our luxury hotel suites in downtown Philadelphia feature soaking tubs or private balconies to soak in the view.

claims.text: At AWAY Spa, treatments start with a signature ginger shot, and the menu includes detox facials and a Balance CBD massage.

findings.quote: Checking in for a treatment starts with a signature ginger shot, and the spa menu features detox facials and the soothing Balance CBD massage.

claims.text: CONTRAST, a sauna and cold-plunge experience, is available as an add-on to a stay.

findings.quote: Level up your fitness routine with CONTRAST, our sauna and cold-plunge experience available as an add-on to your stay

claims.text: WET Deck access is included with facial, body and massage treatments on weekdays.

findings.quote: Access to WET Deck is included with all facial, body, and massage treatments, Monday - Fridays.

claims.text: Stevens' Prophecy is an intimate salon-style space hidden behind a two-way mirror in the Living Room bar.

findings.quote: Behind a two-way mirror at the Living Room, a select few will find Stevens’ Prophecy, an intimate salon-style space.

claims.text: Concierge staff can help with hard-to-get restaurant reservations and private tours at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.

findings.quote: The Whatever/Whenever concierge philosophy means the staff will help with everything from scoring hard-to-get restaurant reservations to arranging a private tour at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.

claims.text: The seventh-floor rooftop terrace has the WET Deck pool, cabanas and a fire pit, with views of City Hall.

findings.quote: A lush, poolside oasis above the street with iconic views of Philadelphia’s City Hall and historic architecture, the seventh-floor rooftop terrace includes our WET Deck, cabanas, fire pit, and event space.

claims.text: The outdoor heated pool is open year-round.

findings.quote: Highlights include our outdoor heated pool, which is open year-round, fire pits, poolside cabanas, our lushly landscaped Secret Garden

claims.text: The Penthouse Suite has river-to-river views from a private balcony and an in-room DJ booth.

findings.quote: Take in Philadelphia’s river-to-river views from your expansive private balcony. Then take over the decks from the in-room DJ booth.

claims.text: The lobby floor tiles are a gridded map art installation reproducing a 19th-century guidebook, a nod to the city's historic grid.

findings.quote: from the lobby’s architectural nods to the city’s historic grid system (the floor tiles are an actual gridded map art installation reproducing a cheeky 19th-century guidebook)

claims.text: The Philly toile bed linens show a muscular Ben Franklin designed by a local art school graduate.

findings.quote: the Philly toile-patterned bed linens show off a muscle-y Ben Franklin designed by a local art school graduate

claims.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Parking at the hotel is by valet.

findings.quote: Our hotel has valet parking only provided by Towne Park.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting comes with typical city noise.
